combat.offer: Bubba: Hold on, darlin'. Before you swing at anything, do you want me to walk you through the buttons?
normal: Bubba: One action each per round, fastest first. Pick a row and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: Attack hits with whatever you hold. Skills is your packed loadout, paid in MP or AP.
Bubba: Reload fills the magazine and covers you for the round. Holding your vector gun, that row is Switch instead.
Bubba: That gun answers to you alone, darlin'. Its modes and its form are set from the main menu.
Bubba: Switch folds it into that form and back again, as often as you like, and costs no turn.
Bubba: Backpack uses what you carry. Actions holds Aim, Throw and Wrestle, plus the kit you never lose.
Bubba: Talk tries words first, some of them listen. Run always works: a corpse learns nothing.
map: Bubba: This one plays out where we are standing, so the map is the arena. Still one action each per round, in order of speed.
Bubba: Move walks you across the tiles before you act, once per round, as far as your legs and your DEX carry you.
Bubba: Attack only reaches as far as the range written on its row, so count the tiles between you and it before you swing.
Bubba: Skills, Actions, Aim, Wrestle, Talk, the backpack and Throw all stand as their own rows out here, only pointed at a tile.
Bubba: The cursor is how you name that tile: step it onto what you want and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: Run walks the whole party out, unless something has hold of us.
combat.rearm: Bubba: No problem darlin', I'm no magic expert but i can reteach you how to shoot your gun! You need to figure out the rest yourself
